title: VIXEN runtime shader cache ignores included GLSL and SDI source changes
body: Changing RecipeGlyphBindings.glsl and generated SDI binding 52 left stale runtime shader and pipeline binaries; each witness required manually advancing VIXEN_CACHE_DIR and VIXEN_SHARED_CACHE_DIR through cache-r768, cache-r768-inline, and cache-r768-canonicalabi epochs to obtain fresh SPIR-V. Cache keys should include transitive shader includes, generated SDI inputs, and the source-composition revision so a glyph binding change invalidates dependent runtime artifacts automatically.
